events.verdict: Okongwu (ATL) gets his hand on the ball during Thompson's (HOU) driving shot attempt and any contact that occurs is incidental.
VanVleet (HOU) and Young (ATL) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter. Young is not dislodged from his position by any contact from VanVleet when he disengages.
Brooks (HOU) reaches in and gets his hand on the ball as Hunter (ATL) grabs the rebound. He briefly wraps his other arm around Hunter, but the contact is marginal.
Brooks (HOU) briefly grabs Hunter's (ATL) arm, but does not affect his ability to set his intended screen.
Young (ATL) briefly grabs Brooks' (HOU) arm before losing his balance on his own accord.
VanVleet (HOU) makes contact to Daniels' (ATL) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul for grabbing Young's (ATL) head during the altercation.
Young (ATL) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul for instigating the altercation with Brooks (HOU).
Young (ATL) is moving laterally and not in a legal guarding position when he attempts to draw the offensive foul, but the contact is marginal and does not affect Thompson's (HOU) SQBR.
The ball is last touched by Daniels (ATL) before going out of bounds.
Hunter (ATL) closes out toward Green (HOU) and stops short and in front of his landing space. The marginal contact is created by Green extending his leg during his shooting motion.
Sengun (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Young (ATL) loses his footing, but does not commit a traveling violation before he is granted a timeout.
Thompson (HOU) avoids making any illegal contact with Young (ATL), who loses his footing on his own accord.
Brooks (HOU) legally contests Hunter's (ATL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Hunter's (ATL) shot attempt goes out of bounds.
Daniels (ATL) reaches in and brushes VanVleet's (HOU) arm.
Hunter (ATL) places a hand on VanVleet's (HOU) body after he releases the pass, but the contact is marginal.
Okongwu (ATL) places a hand on Thompson's (HOU) body after he releases the pass, but the contact is marginal.
